newsitem.title: USA: Bell to connect with Eastern Telelogic.
newsitem.headline: Bell to connect with Eastern Telelogic.

text.p: Bell Atlantic Corp said on Monday that it has signed an agreement with Eastern Telelogic Inc to interconnect their networks in Pennsylvania, New Jersey and Delaware.
The agreement brings Bell a step closer to getting the authority to offer a full package of local and long distance service to customers, the company said.
Both companies will file the agreements with regulators in each state for approval. Decisions are expected by the end of the year, but the agreements become effective immediately, Bell said.

Eastern Telelogic is a competitive access provider that is entering the market to compete with Bell Atlantic and the agreement sets the terms for the competition, said Bell Atlantic spokesman Paul Miller.
